results.title: WSHA focus on employability in Indian hospitality sector: CEO Mandziuk
results.description: The World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance is training two thousand young Indians for hospitality careers. Graduates gain practical experience and secure full-time employment after completing their training. The initiative aims to foster inclusivity and build a resilient workforce for the industry.
